text.9:29: Fight against such of those who have been given the Scripture as believe not in Allah nor the Last Day, and forbid not that which Allah hath forbidden by His messenger, and follow not the Religion of Truth, until they pay the tribute readily, being brought low.
text.9:58: And of them is he who defameth thee in the matter of the alms. If they are given thereof they are content, and if they are not given thereof, behold! they are enraged.
text.20:50: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.
text.53:34: And gave a little, then was grudging?
text.92:5: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
text.93:5: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
text.108:1: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
